Name: Pride Skateboard Retextures
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
Hey y'all, me again, I have once again decided to make a new mod instead of updating old ones. *sigh*.

Basically, this mod adds in a bunch of Pride themed skateboards, for different genders, sexualities, and romantic orientations. there's even a flag for autistic Pride!
I take suggestions, just please have patience with me.

also NO, I will NOT add a straight pride flag.

[size=4]THIS MOD REQUIRES:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24074]Skateboard 1.6[/url]

DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS: extract the .zip files into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" Folder.

!!do NOT use my mod to train AI!!

[/size][size=3]this mod is only on nexus.[/size][size=4] [/size][size=3]I do not upload any of my mods to other mods sites. If you see my mod elsewhere, it has been stolen and reuploaded.[/size][size=4]

[/size][size=3]Current language: english[/size][size=4]
[/size]if there are any bugs, please provide a SMAPI log, and report in the bugs section, not the comments!
[url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log parser link[/url]
